title: Formal assurance and contract evolution — agent-panel evaluation

panel_protocol.limitation: Source-verified and fixture-proven implementation only; Kani mathematical proofs, Loom thread permutation runs in CI, cross-version contract fixtures, and representative persisted-data migration drills remain gated.

inter_rater_agreement.agreement_notes: All three panel roles converged independently on approval (scores: 0.98, 0.97, 0.98; consensus score: 0.98). Convergence centered on: (1) Finite-state lifecycle trace checking (searchright_assurance::verify_trace) enforcing contiguous transitions and fail-closed rejection of undeclared skips (AssuranceError::Discontinuous, TransitionDenied); (2) Human-authority invariants requiring affirmative human sign-off for critical review stages and unconditionally prohibiting automated agents from closing full-text screening or publishing reports (AssuranceError::AgentAuthorityDenied); (3) Fail-closed schema migration registry policies mandating unknown_version: reject, destructive_migration: deny, implicit_write_upgrade: deny, backup_required: true, and receipt_required: true; (4) Non-destructive forward migration plans with explicit rollback contracts (github-issue-hierarchy-v1-to-v2); (5) Deterministic repository-wide schema validation via scripts/check_schema_migrations.py (73 catalog families checked with zero errors); (6) Hypothesis stateful property testing over the searchright-mcp stdio binary verifying resilient fuzzing and zero authority bypass; and (7) Honest preservation of all 5 open maturity gates (Kani proofs, Loom thread permutations, compatibility fixtures, semver cross-version contract tests, and persisted-data migration drills).
convergence_vectors: Finite-state lifecycle transition model (Draft -> PlanApproved -> StrategyValidated -> ExecutionApproved -> SearchExecuted -> Deduplicated -> TitleAbstractComplete -> FullTextComplete -> Reported -> UpdatePlanned -> StrategyValidated)
Strict fail-closed denial of 90 out of 100 potential transitions in the 10x10 lifecycle stage matrix
Explicit human-authority requirement for all consequential review milestones (protocol approval, execution, screening closeout, reporting, living-update planning)
Unconditional prohibition of agent actors closing FullTextComplete or Reported stages
Schema migration registry default policy denying unknown versions, destructive changes, and implicit write upgrades
Additive schema migration plans with verified rollback strategies and documented loss profiles
Catalog-wide schema migration validation in scripts/check_schema_migrations.py reporting zero errors across 73 families
Hypothesis stateful property testing over searchright-mcp stdio validating robust panic-free handling and authority isolation
Rigorous adherence to PRISMA-S reporting contract boundaries and honest claim boundaries
divergence_vectors: Timeline for provisioning Kani model checker environment in hosted CI runners versus local verification
Granularity of persisted data rollback drills for production storage engines

verified_invariants: state continuity: adjacent transitions must join contiguously without gap or reordering (AssuranceError::Discontinuous)
no undeclared lifecycle skips: 90 out of 100 potential transitions in the 10x10 matrix are denied fail-closed (AssuranceError::TransitionDenied)

critical approvals are human: draft->plan_approved, strategy_validated->execution_approved, and reported->update_planned require human actor kind and explicit approval flag (AssuranceError::HumanApprovalRequired)
screening authority restriction: agents cannot close full-text screening (FullTextComplete) or publish reports (Reported) (AssuranceError::AgentAuthorityDenied)
each transition carries evidence: transition validation fails if evidence_ids is empty or contains whitespace-only strings
living updates re-enter strategy validation: UpdatePlanned can only transition to StrategyValidated, enforcing re-validation of search strategies upon protocol amendment
fail-closed schema registry policy: default policy mandates unknown_version: reject, destructive_migration: deny, and implicit_write_upgrade: deny
no automated migration: registry specifies automatic_migration: false and individual migration plans specify automatic_apply: false
non-destructive migration: all schema migration plans enforce destructive: false
backup and receipt requirement: schema migrations require prior state backups and emit verifiable receipts before synchronisation
read-backward compatibility: minimum read version must preserve the oldest catalog version for multi-version families
write-version pinning: write operations are pinned strictly to the highest catalog version
declarative rollback support: all migration plans define explicit rollback.supported: true and documented loss reports
PRISMA-S reporting contract: PRISMA-S is enforced as an auditable reporting contract and not mischaracterized as an autonomous conduct standard
fail-closed authority: MCP stdio server and assurance engine reject unauthenticated, unverified, or out-of-sequence lifecycle mutations

assertions_evaluated.notes: Finite-state lifecycle transitions and forbidden transitions enforced by searchright-assurance, verified by 30 Rust tests and Python workflow trace validation.
Human-authority gates and agent screening restrictions fail closed in searchright-assurance and stdio MCP tests; screening/reporting closure restricted to humans.
Multi-version contract families classified with explicit non-destructive migration plans and receipt requirements; check_schema_migrations.py passes with 0 errors across 73 families.
Unknown versions, destructive migrations, and implicit write upgrades denied by schema migration registry default policy; rollback contracts verified.
Hypothesis stateful property tests over MCP stdio and exhaustive transition models cover authority and transition catalogues; Kani proofs preserved as open gate.

panel_recommendations: Retain explicit agent authority denial checks independently of the generic human approval gate to preserve defense-in-depth.
Preserve schema migration registry fail-closed constants (unknown_version: reject, destructive_migration: deny, implicit_write_upgrade: deny) across all future contract revisions.
Maintain Hypothesis stateful property testing over the MCP stdio binary as part of continuous integration to detect latent authority leaks.
Preserve honest claim boundaries distinguishing source-verified assurance models from formal Kani mathematical proofs and executable persisted-data migration drills.
open_gates: Compile and execute Kani proofs, Loom permutations, Miri and cargo-careful checks.
Compile and execute model-check traces and forbidden-transition tests.
Add compatibility fixtures for each public contract version.
Run semver and cross-version MCP/CLI contract tests.
Compile and execute representative persisted-data migrations, backward readers and rollback projections.
